pages.text: In order to obtain The Guardian Eye, you must defeat the Realm Warden, an ancient war machine left over from a bygone era.
The Realm Warden is found in the deepest part of underground structures, which can only be found by following the Eye of Coreforge Ruins.
Defeating the Realm Warden grants a Guardian Core, possessing unknown power (W.I.P)
Corpse Warlock spawns in the Nether dimension. It possesses the ability to manipulate corpses in combat and can enhance its summoned minions as well as absorb them.
